comment_regular: Verified local operation: returns whether TESForm flags at +0x08 contain bit 0x8000. Probable role: visible-distant flag, corroborated by the identical local bit check in Fallout's named TESObjectREFR::GetVisibleDistant and by Oblivion's distant model queue callers. Divergence: Fallout also falls back to the base form's bit when the reference bit is clear; this Oblivion helper checks only the reference's own flags.
